meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
India mein **budget wedding sarees** ke liye aap online ye options dekh sakte ho: **Meesho, Myntra, Flipkart, Sudathi, Libas, Mohey (Manyavar), aur Amrut Fashion**. Inme Meesho aur Myntra par sabse saste options mil rahe hain, jabki Mohey, Libas aur Utsav Fashion mein thode better festive/bridal-looking sarees milte hain.[1][12][15][18][8][4][13][2]

Aapke budget ke hisaab se practical shortlist:

- **Under ₹500**: Meesho aur Myntra par *sarees under 500* / *silk sarees below 500* jaise budget options milte hain.[15][18]
- **₹500–₹1,500**: Meesho aur Mohey par everyday-to-festive look wali affordable sarees mil sakti hain; Mohey ki list mein ₹1,499 se items dikh rahe hain.[15][12]
- **₹1,500–₹5,000**: Amrut Fashion aur Sudathi mein sale par wedding-style sarees mil sakti hain; Amrut par ₹2,499 sale price aur Sudathi par budget-friendly wedding collection mention hai.[13][8]
- **₹5,000+**: Libas, Utsav Fashion, Nalli aur Kankatala jaise stores mein more premium wedding sarees milengi.[4][2][5][6]

**Shaadi ke liye budget mein best fabric choices**:
- **Silk / Pattu look**: Traditional wedding feel deta hai.[15][19]
- **Banarasi-style**: Shaadi ke liye classic aur dressy lagta hai.[9][12]
- **Organza / Georgette**: Lightweight aur budget-friendly festive look ke liye achha hota hai.[12][15]

**Meri simple recommendation**:
- Agar **minimum budget** hai, to **Meesho** aur **Myntra** check karo.[1][15][18]
- Agar **thoda better wedding look** chahiye without spending too much, to **Sudathi, Amrut Fashion, aur Mohey** dekhna best rahega.[8][13][12]
- Agar **bride ke liye heavy look** chahiye, to **Libas, Nalli, Utsav Fashion** aur **Kankatala** better hain.[4][5][2][6]

Agar tum chaho, main **₹1,000 / ₹2,000 / ₹5,000** ke budget ke hisaab se *exact saree types* bhi shortlist kar deta hoon.
